articles.title: RDP Calls for Closing the Door to Any Possibility of AI Bailout
articles.description: As financial markets increasingly look to be buckling under the weight of the AI industry’s accounting and economic model contradictions, the Revolving Door Project is renewing our call for Democrats to preemptively reject any consideration—under any circumstance—of public funds to bail the industry out of its financial precarity. In August, we wrote that lawmakers must “take the simple and clear public stance of opposing any bailout for an “industry” that has generated far more arrogance and distress than productivity or happiness.” Revolving Door Project Executive Director Jeff Hauser issued the following statement: “As Anthropic’s founders are already cashing out, SpaceX (which now contains XAI) continues to slide, and as a regulatory gift basket for the industry is jammed through Congress, bypassing regular procedure and ignoring Democrats’ mandate from the midterm elections, it is more important than ever to brace for corporate America’s imminent dusting off of the “now is not the time to oppose moral hazard” playbook.” “The AI industry did not consult the public in its disastrous financing, in fact it often aggressively obscured the details from communities and sought to trample democratic oversight. This disastrous speculative bubble has siphoned off enormous amounts of public money already, poisoned communities, eroded cyber infrastructure, and derailed the work of moving to a green economy. The public has already subsidized more than its fair share of the costs of this boondoggle. So when the industry comes hat in hand begging for us to save them from themselves, the message must be unequivocal: not one dollar more.”
